Remove npm/PyPI packages not downloaded in 60 days
while true; do ping localhost; sleep 60; done

until [ -f /snapshots/kopia.repository.f ]; do
    printf "\e[1;32m%-6s\e[m\n" "Waiting for the Kopia repo to become ready ..."
    sleep 1
done

kopia repository connect filesystem \
  --path=/snapshots \
  --override-hostname=cluster \
  --override-username=root \
&& exec kopia server start \
  --insecure \
  --address 0.0.0.0:80 \
  --metrics-listen-addr 0.0.0.0:8080 \
  --without-password \
  --log-level debug

version: v1
flags:
  migStrategy: none
sharing:
  timeSlicing:
    renameByDefault: false
    failRequestsGreaterThanOne: false
    resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        replicas: 6
